newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-United Waste FY97 raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-United Waste FY97 raised.

text.p: -- Gruntal & Co said Wednesday it raised its estimate for United Waste Systems Inc's earnings for 1997 to $1.54 from $1.42 and raised its 12-month price target to $52 from $42.
-- Gruntal cited the company's continued acquisition activity and ongoing growth in its solid waste markets. Gruntal also set an initial estimate for fiscal 1998 of $1.96.

-- United Waste completed acquisitions that added more than $70 million in annualized revenues in the final months of 1996, Gruntal said. For all of 1996, the company's purchases were worth $152 million to its annual rvenues, Gruntal said.
-- United Waste operates landfills, waste collection companies and waste transfer stations. Its shares were trading up 1/4 Wednesday at 36-3/4.
